name: livespec-overseer
description: Control-plane operator plugin for livespec. Exposes /livespec-overseer:overseer for the thin two-pane overseer surface, /livespec-overseer:caam-anthropic-loop for caam-managed Claude Max quota watching and account rotation, and /livespec-overseer:drain-backlog for draining a repository's open backlog through the factory in ruled batches.
